Syntax: (automatic skill)
              |
              |        Counter is an advanced defensive fighting technique that
              |        allows you to automatically reverse an opponent's attack
              |        and hit them back with half the damage they were attempting
              |        to deal. It triggers automatically when you are attacked.
              |
              |        Success depends on:
              |          - Your counter skill level
              |          - Your level compared to attacker
              |          - Your dexterity versus theirs
              |          - Your weapon skill compared to theirs
              |          - Your strength versus theirs
              |
              |        When successful, your counter attack deals half damage
              |        to the attacker and improves your counter skill.
              |
              |        Requirements:
              |          - You must be awake
              |          - You must have a weapon equipped
              |          - You must be able to see your attacker
              |          - You must have learned counter skill
              |
              |        Counter is a passive skill that activates automatically
              |        during combat. Train it to increase your defense and
              |        improve your chances of turning the tide of battle.
              |
              |        Related: armor class, dodge, parry, defend
              |
